notes: Ingredient ID corresponds to a concept in the NHANES Ingredient vocabulary; would be stored as concept_id in the concept table.
Ingredient name stored as concept_name in the concept table.
Blend component ID corresponds to a concept; would be stored as concept_id in the concept table.
Blend component name stored as concept_name in the concept table.
Blend component category stored as concept_class_id in the concept table.
Old blend component ID corresponds to a concept; would be stored as concept_id in the concept table.
